purpose: Out-of-sample relative to Stage12-19 calendar dates for frozen V4 D1 quality filter and bounded risk exit; no in-run tuning
date_rule: Fixed four calendar 13th days in months absent from Stage12-19; no return or signal data consulted
symbol_universe: Frozen Stage12 504 current Spot USDT plus Stage15 254 archive-only ASCII USDT Spot, 758 symbols total; not historical point-in-time exchangeInfo
historical_input: Official Binance daily Spot 1m ZIP with publisher SHA256, 60h contiguous warmup/forward, same production V4 D0/D1

baseline.trigger: V4 production SETUP_ACTIVE from full calendar replay

quality_gate.btc_source: Same verified Binance BTCUSDT official 1m archive, only past 60m returns

risk_exit.start: D1 SETUP + 3 min 1m OPEN entry proxy
risk_exit.stop_gap_execution: MIN(first_1m_open, target_stop), never better than target_stop

gate_for_further_research.notify_increase_over_baseline: NONE: applied only to existing D1, WATCH remains unchanged

failure_rule: Record all holdouts; NO_GO if inadequate n, negative median, profitability not robust at 100bps, integrity failure or excessive censoring; no parameter switches after viewing results
limitations: 2026-10 inventory is survivor-listed, not exact historical tradability
1m high/low stop-first simulated exit is not executable fill
Only four holdout day slices, not year-round GT recall or real FPR
All 100bps scenarios separately reported without replacing 20bps prereg baseline
Independent AI review, Mac install, Gmail and trading stay disabled
